svg.title: Throughput
svg.desc: Fans send checkouts through 10 web servers into a lock on the event row, then into the orders database. The lock lets only one checkout through at a time, so a line of waiting checkouts builds up while the web servers sit mostly idle. Then the lock is split into 40 section locks, the line drains, and finished checkouts jump from 200 to 4,000 a second.
svg.text: One lock lets 200 a second through and a line forms. 40 locks clear it.
